page.overview:
Who is Reelo Baruk?

Reelo Baruk was a male Rodian gangster from Nar Shaddaa.

In 1 ABY, Baruk was working for Jabba Desilijic Tiure on Tatooine. Living in Jabba's Palace, his job was to hire spacers to eliminate Jabba's enemies, such as the Alkhara Bandits or the Valarians. There, he also contacted a local spacer to deal with Jabba's Sand People problem.

Baruk eventually moved to Nar Shaddaa, and opened a bar and also began his own criminal empire. Most people just saw him as the head of a local garbage-hauling company, but this was not the case. He worked very hard to keep his criminal activity under the radar. His thugs were of many different alien species, and were considered some of the worst scum in the galaxy.

In the years leading to 12 ABY, the New Republic had no evidence about Baruk's criminal activities, seemingly turning to clean business. He operated a company for garbage hauling and disposal, and managed to register it officially with the Republic, something that would make him the only legitimate business man on Nar Shadda.
